x_food_stamps_ecd548_01.desc: Being enrolled in college does not mean your grocery bill disappears. SNAP rules should reflect that.

x_food_stamps_ecd548_02.desc: Why do some students have to navigate extra eligibility rules just because they attend college? What would a workable policy look like?

x_food_stamps_ecd548_03.desc: Campus food pantries are helpful, but they should not be the only answer to student hunger.

x_food_stamps_ecd548_04.desc: Working a part-time job and taking a full course load can still leave students short on food. Curious how others see this.

x_food_stamps_ecd548_05.desc: Would easier SNAP access help more students finish their degrees?

x_food_stamps_ecd548_06.desc: A student skipping meals to pay for textbooks is not a success story.

x_food_stamps_ecd548_07.desc: SNAP eligibility for students should be easier to understand, even if the income limits stay.

x_food_stamps_ecd548_08.desc: Should financial aid offices help students apply for food benefits at enrollment?

x_food_stamps_ecd548_09.desc: Not every college student needs SNAP, but eligible students should not face unnecessary hurdles.

x_food_stamps_ecd548_10.desc: Food insecurity can damage academic performance long before anyone notices. Thoughts?

x_food_stamps_ecd548_11.desc: Should community college and university students face the same SNAP access rules?

x_food_stamps_ecd548_12.desc: Some students juggle childcare, classes, and work. Food assistance rules need to see the whole picture.

x_food_stamps_ecd548_13.desc: A simpler benefits application could save students time they do not have.

x_food_stamps_ecd548_14.desc: How do we expand student food assistance without making eligibility meaningless? Anyone seen this handled well locally?

x_food_stamps_ecd548_15.desc: College dining plans do not automatically solve off-campus hunger.

x_food_stamps_ecd548_16.desc: SNAP reform for students should include better outreach, not just changes to the law.

x_food_stamps_ecd548_17.desc: Students who qualify for support should not need to decode a maze of exemptions.

x_food_stamps_ecd548_18.desc: Would expanded SNAP access help adult learners returning to school?

x_food_stamps_ecd548_19.desc: Is it reasonable to expect full-time students to meet the same work conditions as everyone else?

x_food_stamps_ecd548_20.desc: Feeding students should be a basic part of discussing college affordability.
